faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about Midjourney-style text to image generation

q1.question: How does Midjourney-style generation work?
q1.answer: Our AI model is trained to generate images with artistic qualities similar to Midjourney, focusing on aesthetic appeal, creative interpretation, and professional-quality outputs. Simply describe your vision in natural language.

q2.question: What makes this different from other AI image generators?
q2.answer: Midjourney-style generation emphasizes artistic quality, creative interpretation, and aesthetic appeal. It excels at producing visually striking images with strong composition and artistic coherence.

q3.question: Can I use generated images commercially?
q3.answer: Yes, images generated through our platform can be used for commercial purposes. Please review our terms of service for specific usage rights and attribution requirements.

q4.question: How detailed should my prompts be?
q4.answer: More detailed prompts generally produce better results. Include subject matter, artistic style, mood, lighting, composition, and any specific visual elements you want. For example: "ethereal forest landscape, golden hour lighting, impressionist style, soft focus, dreamy atmosphere".

q5.question: What resolution are the generated images?
q5.answer: Generated images are high-resolution and suitable for most professional uses including web, print, and presentations. Optional upscaling is available for even higher resolution outputs.
